Meet Khadija: business owner, community builder and definitely pretty badass. Hosting pop-ups across the city, Khadija gives local vendors, musicians and artists the necessary spotlight and opportunity to stand center stage. #ad For me, this one is personal. Breast cancer has touched my family more than once. Two of my aunts and a cousin have faced it, and so has one of my friends. Like so many Canadians, it's a reminder of just how many lives are impacted. That's why I'm taking part in the Canadian Cancer Society CIBC Run for the Cure. For one powerful day, people across Canada come together to run, walk, fundraise and honour the important people in our lives affected by breast cancer. But the impact lasts far beyond that one day. One Day. Endless Impact. Every step taken and every dollar raised helps power life-saving breast cancer research, compassionate support programs and future breakthroughs—giving hope to people affected by breast cancer today and for generations to come. The end of the Run is just the beginning. Your participation today helps fuel tomorrow's breakthroughs. Whether you run, walk or simply want to support the cause, I'd love for you to join me.
